title: Chapter 408 Snow Ape Boss
content:
Chapter 408 Snow Ape Boss

Wang Shuo and others did not pursue.

After picking up a few wolf corpses, everyone continued to advance towards the Great Snow Mountain.

After walking for half an hour, everyone finally found the first snow ape.

The snow ape was nearly 5 meters tall, covered with thick fur, walked upright, but had a monkey head.

Wang Shuo immediately took up his gun and wanted to test the power of this snow ape.

The Overlord Spear slashed across the chest of the snow ape, directly pulling out a long cut.

This snow ape only has the strength of a silver boss. Although it is huge, it is not strong enough.

Wang Shuo killed it easily.

After ordering people to peel off the fur of the snow ape, Wang Shuo warned everyone: "It seems that we have entered the Great Snow Mountain. I am afraid that various boss-level monsters will appear one after another. We must get as many furs and magic cores as possible."

After that, Wang Shuo took out the magic core in the snow ape's brain. It was similar to the demon pill. The magic core was like crystal, and you could feel the rich energy contained in it.

In the Great Snow Mountain, various magical beasts are the main targets of the generals. In addition, there are various rich ores and other resources, which are also collected by the generals.

Unlike the ores in the mines, the ores on the Great Snow Mountain are mostly exposed on the surface. Some ores cannot be covered by ice and snow, so they are easy to find.

Wang Shuo's goal of this trip is naturally these ores. You must know that high-level ores that are rarely seen in the outside world are common here.

Wang Shuo searched around and easily found ores for forging gold-level weapons, as well as some hard wood, all of which are good things.

As the crowd continued to go deeper, the level of the snow ape became higher and higher, but Zhu Dongheng and Wang Shuo and other generals did not make any more moves.

The purpose of this trip is to let the generals under their command stimulate their potential as much as possible and break through the generals, so they need to fight more.

Finally, after 2 hours of searching, they found a snow ape at the level of a general.

Ayub, Ye Tianba and others immediately stepped forward, surrounded the snow ape, and prepared to launch an attack.

Wang Shuo and the other four were on the side.

The snow ape saw that he was surrounded, and slapped his chest vigorously with both hands, warning this group of people with bad intentions.

But no matter how the snow ape roared, it could not scare everyone away.

Gong Zheng took the lead in attacking.

A move of "Taishan Pressure" was followed by another move of "Taunting".

Directly pulled the hatred of the snow ape firmly.

Ayubu, Ye Tianba and others also immediately joined the battle, and all kinds of fierce attacks were imposed on the snow ape.

But the snow ape at the level of the general had amazing defense. Ayubu's "Lightning Rising Dragon Strike" only caused slight damage to the snow ape.

This shocked everyone.

As for the assassin Guliji, she didn't even break the defense.

But everyone was not panicked. First, there were masters behind them, so there was no danger to their lives. Second, everyone had experience fighting against general-level bosses, and they were still confident.

As the battle deepened, everyone's cooperation became more and more seamless.

The wounds on the snow ape continued to increase, and his physical strength was also declining.

The attack was no longer as swift as before.

Everyone used their ultimate moves at the same time in tacit agreement, knocking the snow ape to the ground.

The snow ape's head was hit hard by Ye Tianba and Lin Dabiao, and its brain was blown out.

It was obvious that it would not survive.

After a while, Ye Tianba dug out a 4th-level magic core.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction. In this battle, the cooperation of several people was quite perfect.

After walking for most of the day, everyone felt a little hungry, so they made a fire on the spot and roasted the snow ape meat.

Wang Shuo was not worried that making a fire would attract other monsters, which would save a lot of trouble. Since it was blind and came to the door, he killed it directly to take the magic core.

Going deep into the Great Snow Mountain, the monsters encountered became increasingly scarce, and the temperature was also lower.

Wang Shuo and others ate some hot food to replenish their physical strength.

At this time, a beast roar sounded in the distance.
